title: Middle Eastern Lamb Shakshuka
description: A flavorful and spicy lamb shakshuka dish inspired by Middle Eastern cuisine, perfect for a hearty dinner.
instructions: Season the lamb with salt, pepper, and middle eastern spices.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe pan over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb for 2-3 minutes on each side, then set aside.
Add the sliced onion to the pan and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the shakshuka to the pan and stir to combine.
Return the lamb to the pan and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked through and the shakshuka is heated through.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
